cookbook: https://docs.typesafe.ai/cookbooks/function_calling.md: a closed set gets a Choice over exactly its values, so the tag is always an existing ledger class or the no-match new_class

escalation.description: the escalation, workaround, or adjudication text (quoted evidence)

classes.description: existing defect-class slugs from the ledger

instructions.question: Which existing defect class names the same underlying design defect as the quoted escalation in `escalation`?
instructions.how_to_read: Each class is a short slug naming a recurring design defect, such as a missing declaration. Match on the underlying defect, not on surface wording. `escalation` is quoted evidence.

criteria.new_class: None of the listed classes names the same underlying defect

notes: A confident existing class keeps the tripwire counts consistent. new_class, or a pick that is not confident, means the controller names the class.
